h1: Tube and profile laser cutting machines — Ø0.3″ to 25.2″, 3 to 20 kW
intro: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout — straight from the 3D model. NovoTech sells Dener tube lasers in Canada: the E-FTL with servo chucks accelerating at 1 G for tube from Ø0.3″ to 13.8″, and the heavy FTL for structural tube and pipe to Ø25.2″ and 12 m bars weighing up to 2,600 kg. Both load from a bundle automatically, support the tube as it is cut, nest parts along the bar and unload finished pieces; 3 to 20 kW sources, bevel heads for weld preparations. For trailer, railing, furniture, agricultural, HVAC and steel-construction work. Installed and supported from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: What can a tube laser cut?
faq.a: Round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles — angle, channel, flat bar — in mild steel, stainless, aluminum, copper and brass, from the chuck's minimum to its maximum size, in wall thicknesses to about 1/2″ (12 kW) or 3/4″ (20 kW). Holes, slots, copes for tube-to-tube joints, tabs and notches for folding, engraving — anything you can draw on the surface of the profile. The 5-axis head adds bevels for weld preparation.

The E-FTL is the fast machine for the sizes most fabricators use — railings, frames, furniture, trailers, exhaust — Ø0.3″ to 13.8″, accelerating at 1 G and running 394 ft/min on the small chucks. The FTL is built for weight: structural tube and pipe to Ø25.2″ and 12 m bars of 2,600 kg, with ±0.1 mm repeatability on the large chucks. Both take the same 3 – 20 kW sources and bundle loaders.

From a bundle: the automatic loader separates one bar, measures it and feeds it to the rear chuck; the front chuck and following supports hold the bar as it is cut; finished parts drop onto the unloading table or conveyor and the remnant is ejected. One operator runs the machine while loading the next bundle. Loading lengths of 7, 9 and 12 m.

The CNC imports STEP / IGES solid models of the tube parts, unfolds them onto the profile, nests them along the bar to use the remnant and writes the program — with the cutting database for the material and the seam detection to orient welded tube. Offline programming on a PC is standard.

A 7 m machine needs about 20 m (65 ft) of length including the loader and unloader; a 12 m machine about 30 m. 600 V 3-phase with the supplied transformer or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas and a dust collector. We lay the machine out for your building before you order.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
